GET /tenants/{tenant_id}/accounts.description:
Lists the Cloudflare accounts associated with this tenant using the legacy Account response
shape. Use `GET /organizations/{organization_id}/accounts` for the modern Account response.
Use `page_token` and `page_size` for cursor pagination, or provide `page` and `per_page`
together for legacy offset pagination. Cursor pagination takes precedence when requested.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The ID of the tenant whose accounts to list.

parameters.name: account_pubname
parameters.description:
(case-sensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the account_pubname is equal to
a particular string.

parameters.name: account_pubname.startsWith
parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the account_pubname starts with
a particular string.

parameters.name: account_pubname.endsWith
parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the account_pubname ends with
a particular string.

parameters.name: account_pubname.contains
parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the account_pubname contains
a particular string.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
(case-sensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the name is equal to a
particular string.

parameters.name: name.startsWith
parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the name starts with a
particular string.

parameters.name: name.endsWith
parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the name ends with a particular
string.

parameters.name: name.contains
parameters.description:
(case-insensitive) Filter the list of accounts to where the name contains a particular
string.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter accounts by lifecycle status. Defaults to `active`.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Field to order results by. Currently supported values: `account_name`.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
Sort direction for the order_by field. Valid values: `asc`, `desc`.
Defaults to `asc` when order_by is specified.

parameters.name: include_total
parameters.description:
Whether to calculate and return the exact `result_info.total_size` for cursor
pagination. Defaults to true. When false, `total_size` is omitted. Legacy
`page`/`per_page` requests always calculate `total_count`.

Legacy offset page number. Must be provided with `per_page`. Values below 1 are treated as
1. Cursor pagination takes precedence when requested.
parameters.name: page

parameters.description:
Legacy offset page size. Must be provided with `page`. Values are clamped to the range
1-100. Cursor pagination takes precedence when requested.
parameters.name: per_page

parameters.description:
An opaque token returned from the last list response that when
provided will retrieve the next page.

Parameters used to filter the retrieved list must remain in subsequent
requests with a page token.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: The amount of items to return. Defaults to 10.
parameters.name: page_size

next_page_token.description:
Use this opaque token in the next request to retrieve the
next page.

Parameters used to filter the retrieved list must remain in subsequent
requests with a page token.

total_size.description: Counts the total amount of items in a list with the applied filters. The API omits next_page_token to indicate no more items in a particular list.

4XX.description: The request failed due to a client error.

5XX.description: The request failed due to a server error.
